description: This file contains functions for mutating and updating Excalidraw elements, including handling element updates, versioning, and specific logic for elbow arrow elements.

methods.name: mutateElement
methods.description: Updates an Excalidraw element with new properties, handling specific cases for elbow arrows and recalculating size and versioning.

methods.name: newElementWith
methods.description: Creates a new element by applying updates to an existing element, optionally forcing regeneration.

methods.name: bumpVersion
methods.description: Increments the version, versionNonce, and updated timestamp of an element.
